issues.evidence: The Accept-all 'peak' is a 3.5 s gain bump (vol .30) under VO that the bed sidechain (ratio 8) ducks. The curve reads -14.3 at 91.5 against -14.8 at 78.5, and dynamic_sections show no section change between 78 and 120 (-18.8).
issues.suggested_action: Make the peak an arrangement event, not a fader ride: cut to the track's fullest section or add a hit at 92.3, clear the VO from 92.0-93.2, and lower the duck depth to about 6 dB.

issues.evidence: The whole post-reveal score is one Mixkit track ('Digital Clouds') played continuously from src 0 to 75. The 'build/lift/settle' exists only as volume steps (.16/.21/.30/.19/.06/.26/.18).
issues.suggested_action: Edit the stock cue at its phrase boundaries: sparse intro under 49-78, a section change at the 78 split, the fullest section at 91, a breakdown at 117. Or use a stem-based cue so the build happens by layering.

issues.evidence: Measured cuts_on_sound_pct 36. The score never accents a cut: the 78.0 split, the 102 team, the 118.3 payoff and the 127.3 end card all lack a musical downbeat. At 127.3 the music returns 0.3 s late with a 0.8 s fade-in.
issues.suggested_action: Slip the score so that downbeats fall on 78.0, 91.0, 118.3 and 127.3 (time-stretch ≤3% or edit bars), and start the end-card cue with a hard downbeat at 127.3.

issues.evidence: The ending is a 2.0 s fade (silence from 132.45) with the identity chime at 130.8 over the 'Agentic Office.' VO at 130.9. There is no button or sting to land the brand line.
issues.suggested_action: End on a single sustained chord or button at 131.9, one beat after 'Agentic Office.', then a clean 1.2 s ring-out to black at 133.4.

issues.evidence: The logo and promise at 46 sit in near-silence with only identity.mp3 at 46.2. The score enters at 49.0 on the warm-room cut, 3 s after the reveal.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the silence through 'See exactly what changed.' but place a soft pad entry or swell under the logo at 46.2, and let the full bed ignite at 49.0 on the cut.

issues.evidence: Hook arc: hazy jazz 5.05-17.45 (the helpful-AI mood), suspense 17.3-41.6, heartbeat, riser 38.6-41.6, then silence. This maps well to the grind. But it uses a different musical world from the product score, with no thread between them.
issues.suggested_action: Tie the halves together: let the suspense cue share the product score's key or a two-note interval, so the 49 s ignition resolves what the hook left hanging.

issues.evidence: The 'swell on Sent' (vol .26 at 120.3) starts with the VO line 'Done. And this time...', so the sidechain flattens it.
issues.suggested_action: Start the swell at 119.9 on the lights-on cut, let it peak before the VO, and enter the VO at 120.8.
